change: Add existing highConfidenceContradictionRisk telemetry to the generic exact pair×horizon repeat-state signature. It only contributes the existing -0.9 repeat-loss adjustment after same-track lossRun>=2 and when contradiction losses outnumber wins by more than one. No single-event penalty, no veto, no confidence-floor change, no cadence reduction and no direct direction flip.
scope: All tracks may learn the existing contradiction tag, but activation is strictly exact pair×horizon and outcome-history dependent; there is no pair-specific hard-coded penalty.
expectedEffect: Reduce confidence/ranking overstatement during repeated contradiction-driven loss states, especially GBPUSD 1M, while preserving frequency and allowing other regimes/tracks to remain unchanged.
